scientific_integrity: Analytic monomial normalization, gamma-ratio asymptotics, and weighted lattice counting establish the reported coefficient. Finite code checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only isotropic power Fock weights and one coordinate Hankel symbol. Earlier Schatten threshold and moment diagonalization are acknowledged. Some pertinent older full texts could not be inspected; exact Weyl priority remains provisional.
title: A sharp angular Weyl law for coordinate Hankel operators on radial power Fock spaces
